kiosk_idle_timeout_truth.spec_S1_assumption_check: Spec says 90s → overlay. ACTUAL behavior: warning overlay 'Toujours là ?' fires at 150000ms (idleMs - confirmMs). Spec assumption is OFF BY 60s minimum. Owner: lower idleMs in admin settings if 90s is the validated UX target.

no_timer_routes.rationale: idle = no order in-flight ; payment = client at TPE (no screen touch) ; confirmation = receipt display ; waiting = order accepted by KDS
no_timer_routes.spec_S4_impact: S4 says 'Cart fill + 5min idle → overlay'. ACTUAL: cart route (kiosk.cart) IS in timer list (NOT excluded), so timer DOES fire at 150s warning + 180s reset (NOT 5min). Spec timing wrong; behavior correct.
no_timer_routes.spec_S1_payment_drop: Reinforces NETDROP findings: kiosk.payment screen has NO inactivity reset to protect mid-TPE transaction → 'walk away' on payment screen leaves kiosk stuck visually until manual reset OR until backend FrontendOrder reconcile cycle. Documented invariant, not bug.

ui_labels.title: Toujours là ? (kiosk.inactivity.title)
ui_labels.desc: Votre commande sera effacée dans {N} secondes (kiosk.inactivity.desc)

inactivity_overlay_anatomy.spec_says_recommencer: Spec S1 calls button 'Recommencer'. ACTUAL label = 'Abandonner' (leave) or 'Je suis là' (stay). NO 'Recommencer' button on the overlay — that's the post-reset landing on /kiosk/idle which shows the welcome screen.
inactivity_overlay_anatomy.a11y_proof: aria-live=polite on countdown ; focus-trap implied by dialog ; lang-fr labels validated (resources/lang/fr/kiosk.php contains kiosk.inactivity.* keys)

cart_dedup_invariant.spec_S2_impact: S2 says 'rapid tap on category tile → no duplicate cart entries'. ACTUAL: cart dedup happens at MUTATION layer — even if 10 dispatches fire, identical-content items MERGE not DUPLICATE. Verdict GREEN by design.

idle_screen_tap_protection.handler: selectOrderTypeAndStart() at line 257-262 emits 'start-order' event to KioskAppComponent
idle_screen_tap_protection.navigation: KioskAppComponent.startOrder() at line 948-953: resets cart, sets order type, router.push({name:'kiosk.categories'})
idle_screen_tap_protection.no_explicit_debounce: true — relies on vue-router idempotency for same-route push
idle_screen_tap_protection.spec_S2_impact: S2 says 'tap Commencer 10x in 2s → single navigation'. ACTUAL: NO disabled state, NO debounce, NO inFlight guard. Vue Router push to same named route is idempotent (returns same NavigationDuplicated promise). Functionally GREEN but FRAGILE — first slow dispatch could allow concurrent reset() + setOrderType() races. RECOMMEND: add `data-clicked` flag in KioskIdleScreenComponent (S2-P3-01).
idle_screen_tap_protection.evidence_existing_e2e: tests/playwright/kiosk-spa-black-screen-guard.spec.js exists (per router comment line 5) — confirms historical fast-tap regression was caught.

browser_navigation_guards.popstate_handler: ABSENT — grep for popstate|beforeRouteLeave|beforeRouteEnter on kiosk components returns ZERO matches
browser_navigation_guards.wizard_back_uses: KioskWizardComponent.vue:17,1643,2119 → this.$router.go(-1) (history back, NOT internal step decrement)
browser_navigation_guards.spec_S3_impact: S3 says 'wizard étape 3 → browser back → graceful'. ACTUAL: wizard step is in-component state, NOT URL. Browser back from kiosk.categories with active wizard exits the route to /kiosk/idle (or previous router stack entry). Vuex cart NOT auto-cleared by router exit — wizard temp state lost, partial cart line discarded. Behavior is graceful BUT inconsistent with wizard 'Précédent' button which decrements currentStepIndex in-place. NEEDS_HEAL P2: document expected behavior OR add beforeRouteLeave dialog 'Quitter le wizard ?' (S3-P2-01).

abandoned_pending_counter_cron.search: grep -rn 'PENDING_COUNTER' app/Console/Kernel.php app/Console/Commands/*.php → no scheduled cleanup task
abandoned_pending_counter_cron.spec_S6_impact: Spec S6 says '(V1.0.X cron documented for abandoned PENDING_COUNTER)'. ACTUAL: NO cron exists in HEAD 24bdd946a. PENDING_COUNTER orders persist indefinitely until cashier manually voids OR explicit cancellation. RISK: kiosk PENDING_COUNTER pile-up after weekend / long opening → Z report includes phantom unpaid orders. NEEDS_HEAL P1: PruneAbandonedPendingCounterCommand + Kernel schedule entry (S6-P1-01). Aligned with Plan B introduction (commit 24bdd946a) which created the deferred-encashment pattern WITHOUT the cleanup leg.

S1_wizard_abandonment_mid_flow.actual_behavior: Warning overlay 'Toujours là ?' fires at idleMs-confirmMs = 150000ms (2.5 min). Final reset at 180000ms (3 min). Button on overlay is 'Abandonner' (leave) or 'Je suis là' (stay) — not 'Recommencer'.

db_integrity_proof.orphan_cart_entry: NONE — Vuex cart is in-memory only ; resetKiosk dispatches kioskCart/reset (KioskAppComponent.vue:949) which clears state.items + state.orderRef + state.queueNumber
db_integrity_proof.no_db_write_pre_payment: true — order POST happens at /api/frontend/order ONLY at payment confirmation (KioskPaymentComponent.vue → kioskCart/submitOrder)
db_integrity_proof.verdict: no orphan DB row possible (wizard state is client-only until POST)

recommendations.fix: Either lower admin idleMs to 90000 OR update spec doctrine to '150s warning + 180s reset'

S2_fast_multi_tap_abuse.spec_expects: 10x tap Commencer in 2s → single nav ; rapid tap category tile → no duplicate cart entries
S2_fast_multi_tap_abuse.actual_behavior: Commencer button: NO explicit debounce, BUT vue-router same-name push is idempotent. Category tile → wizard: dedup at ADD_ITEM mutation (item_id + variations + extras + instruction match → MERGE qty).

fragility_proof.race_possible: If first reset() resolves slowly, second tap could re-fire setOrderType() with stale state — minor visual glitch only (state converges)
fragility_proof.existing_regression_guard: tests/playwright/kiosk-spa-black-screen-guard.spec.js (per kioskRoutes.js:5 comment) covers fast-tap black-screen — historical regression already healed

recommendations.issue: No explicit click-debounce on idle Commencer button — relies on vue-router idempotency
recommendations.fix: Add `:disabled=startingOrder` + `startingOrder=true` flag for 300ms after first tap

S3_browser_back_forward_abuse.spec_expects: Wizard étape 3 → browser back → graceful state OR reset ; forward → no error
S3_browser_back_forward_abuse.actual_behavior: Wizard step is in-component state (currentStepIndex), NOT URL-bound. Browser back exits kiosk.categories route entirely → KioskIdleScreenComponent.mounted() (line 240-241) dispatches kioskCart/reset → SAFE reset.

code_evidence.claim: no popstate/beforeRouteLeave guards in kiosk components

S3_browser_back_forward_abuse.ux_inconsistency: Wizard's own 'Précédent' button decrements currentStepIndex IN-PLACE (no URL change). Browser-back from same wizard JUMPS to /kiosk/idle (full reset). Two 'back' affordances with divergent semantics confuses impatient client.
S3_browser_back_forward_abuse.data_integrity_proof: No DB write before payment ; cart reset on idle mount ensures no zombie state

recommendations.issue: Browser back from wizard exits to /kiosk/idle (loses in-progress wizard) — inconsistent with in-wizard 'Précédent' affordance
recommendations.fix: Option A: window.history.pushState on wizard step change so browser-back == 'Précédent'. Option B: beforeRouteLeave dialog 'Quitter la commande ?'.

S4_cart_fill_abandon.spec_expects: Add 5 items, 5 min idle → overlay → reset → cart cleared
S4_cart_fill_abandon.actual_behavior: kiosk.cart route IS in inactivity-eligible routes (NOT in noTimerRoutes). Timer fires at 150s warning + 180s reset (3 min, NOT 5 min). Reset dispatches kioskCart/reset → state.items=[] cleanly.

code_evidence.claim: no DB row created from cart-only state
code_evidence.line: submitOrder is the only POST trigger

S4_cart_fill_abandon.db_integrity_proof: Same as S1 — no orders/order_items DB row until POST /api/frontend/order at payment confirmation. Cart abandon = ZERO DB residue. VERIFIED: no zombie order possible.

recommendations.fix: Same as S1 — align spec or admin settings.

S5_multiple_sessions_overlap.spec_expects: Quick consecutive orders from same kiosk → each session distinct
S5_multiple_sessions_overlap.actual_behavior: After confirmation, kiosk auto-resets to idle (KioskConfirmationComponent.vue:311 dispatch kioskCart/reset). Each new wizard generates fresh idempotency_key UUID v4 at kioskCart.js:702-709 (per NETDROP findings.json:14). Sanctum kiosk:order token is machine-bound (480min TTL), shared across sessions.
S5_multiple_sessions_overlap.data_integrity_proof: Each order has distinct idempotency_key (Vuex idempotency_key regenerated on submitOrder success or on resetKiosk). DB UNIQUE (branch_id, user_id, idempotency_key) prevents collision (migration 2026_05_24_023000_add_user_id_to_orders_idempotency_unique.php per NETDROP).

S6_payment_cancellation_plan_B_walkaway.spec_expects: Plan B redirects to Caisse ; client walks away ; 5 min later returns with ticket → order findable ; after 30 min → auto-cancelled (V1.0.X cron documented)
S6_payment_cancellation_plan_B_walkaway.actual_behavior: Plan B routes to PENDING_COUNTER via FrontendOrderService:206-208 (per NETDROP context). Order persists in DB indefinitely — PosCounterCollectModal can encash any time. NO cron exists for cleanup of stale PENDING_COUNTER.
S6_payment_cancellation_plan_B_walkaway.operational_risk: If 5 kiosk clients/day walk away without paying at Caisse, after 1 month = 150 phantom PENDING_COUNTER rows. Z report SHOULD exclude unpaid orders (verify Z report SQL filters on payment_status != PENDING_COUNTER), but UI dashboard 'Pending counter' count grows unbounded. NF525 chain unaffected (orders never closed) but operational hygiene degrades.
S6_payment_cancellation_plan_B_walkaway.data_integrity_proof: Order findable: YES (POS counter-collect query is status-agnostic, finds by order_id). Auto-cancellation: NO (no cron). Manual encashment ALWAYS possible — no expiry timestamp enforced.

recommendations.issue: Plan B introduced PENDING_COUNTER deferred encashment WITHOUT cleanup cron — risk of unbounded stale rows
recommendations.fix: Add app/Console/Commands/PruneAbandonedPendingCounterCommand.php (cancel PENDING_COUNTER orders older than configurable TTL, default 24h ; emit PendingCounterAbandoned event ; audit_log entry). Schedule in Kernel.php hourly. Verify Z report SQL still excludes PENDING_COUNTER. Document KIOSK_PENDING_COUNTER_TTL_HOURS env var.

recommendations.issue: Z report exclusion of PENDING_COUNTER not yet verified
recommendations.fix: Audit app/Services/Fiscal/ZReportService.php SQL for explicit WHERE payment_status NOT IN (PENDING_COUNTER, PENDING) — add SQL assertion test

owner_manual_verify_5min: 1. Navigate /kiosk/idle on chromium ; tap 'Commencer' 10x in 2s → expect single navigation to /kiosk/categories (no duplicate ; no black screen)
2. Start Sandwich Cayenne wizard, advance to step 2, do nothing 2.5 min → expect 'Toujours là ?' overlay with 'Je suis là' / 'Abandonner' buttons (NOT 'Recommencer')
3. At step 3 of any wizard, press chromium back button → expect return to /kiosk/idle with cart cleared (in-place 'Précédent' button preferred — known UX inconsistency S3-P2-01)
4. Add 5 Bols to cart, wait 3 min on cart screen → expect overlay then full reset

5. Submit order Plan B (KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER=true) ; verify in admin POS /pos counter-collect modal shows the order ; verify NO auto-cancellation cron present (php artisan schedule:list | grep -i counter → empty)
6. Open /admin/orders filter status=PENDING_COUNTER older than 24h → confirm pile-up risk surface (operational not fiscal)
